title: Weigh a Solid
description: Use an analytical balance to collect reproducible mass evidence.

title: Measure Liquid Volume
description: Measure a fixed liquid volume using a calibrated cylinder.

title: Make a Solution
description: Dissolve a weighed solid in solvent and track concentration state.

title: Dilute a Stock Solution
description: Create a target dilution from an aliquot and final volume.

title: Analyze Transmittance of a Dilution
description: Prepare a dye dilution, blank and read a spectrophotometer, then relate transmittance, absorbance, and concentration evidence.

title: Transfer Liquid
description: Move a measured liquid volume between containers without overflow.

title: Hard-Water Calcium Carbonate Precipitation
description: Create a configured calcium carbonate precipitate without treating simulated mass as measurement evidence.

title: Filter a Precipitate
description: Collect a precipitate with filter paper, rinse it, and preserve evidence.

title: Dry and Weigh a Precipitate
description: Dry a precipitate to stable mass and record the calculation evidence.

title: Heat and Reweigh a Carbonate Mixture
description: Add a carbonate sample to a crucible, heat to constant mass, cool before weighing, and calculate composition from mass loss.

title: Paper Chromatography
description: Prepare, spot, develop, mark, measure, and calculate Rf values from a paper chromatogram.

title: Calculate Hardness
description: Calculate mg/L hardness as CaCO3 from precipitate mass and sample volume.

title: Beer's Law Calibration
description: Prepare a dye standard, measure transmittance, and convert it to absorbance evidence.

title: Brass Spectrophotometry
description: Prepare a diluted brass sample and record absorbance evidence for copper percent analysis.

title: Hard Water Gravimetry
description: Precipitate, filter, dry, and weigh calcium carbonate to calculate water hardness.

title: Acid-Base Titration to an Indicator Endpoint
description: Assemble a titration setup, use a seated funnel for burette conditioning and filling, remove it to the workbench, record burette evidence, and calculate acid molarity.

title: Bonding Solids Tests
description: Collect appearance, solubility, conductivity, melting, and magnetism evidence for unknown solids.

title: Redox Titration
description: Standardize or apply permanganate titration evidence to estimate hydrogen peroxide percent.

title: Tablet Separation
description: Use magnetic, solvent, filtration, drying, and mass evidence to separate tablet components.

title: Crystal Violet Kinetics
description: Mix crystal violet with sodium hydroxide and record absorbance evidence over time.

title: Hand-Warmer Calorimetry
description: Calibrate a nested-cup calorimeter, compare candidate salts, and defend an evidence-based hand-warmer design.

title: Titration Curve Analysis
description: Screen acid-base behavior, monitor pH during titration, and calculate unknown molarity.

title: Blue #1 Standard Dilutions
description: Prepare assigned stock-and-water standards and calculate each concentration with the dilution relationship.

title: Blue #1 Percent-Transmittance Measurement
description: Apply wavelength, blank, and cuvette rules to measure and record percent transmittance.

title: Class-Pooled Blue #1 Calibration
description: Preserve source-labeled class rows, compare transformations, and record the confirmed calibration relationship.

title: Hard-Water Practice Preparation
description: Measure and dissolve reactants, then form calcium carbonate through incremental carbonate addition.

title: Gravimetric Vacuum Filtration
description: Preweigh filter paper, assemble a Buchner vacuum station, filter without overflow, and wash a precipitate.

title: Two-Stage Precipitate Drying
description: Dry, break up, redry, cool, and tare-correct a gravimetric precipitate assembly.

title: Inquiry Plan Approval
description: Document an experimental plan with complete evidence requirements and an explicit instructor-approval gate.

title: Two-Sample Hard-Water Inquiry
description: Execute two gravimetric analyses, correct for preconcentration, pool class results, and defend a recommendation.

title: Beverage pH-Volume Titration
description: Run an approved beverage titration while preserving pH-volume, indicator-color, stoichiometric, replicate, and provenance evidence.

title: Micromolar Crystal Violet Dilution Series
description: Prepare four independent crystal-violet standards from micromolar stock using separately assigned pipettes.

title: Crystal Violet Spectrophotometer Calibration
description: Confirm wavelength, blank, and reliability rules before measuring standards and stock.

title: Integrated Rate-Law Comparison
description: Compare zero-, first-, and second-order linearizations, select the best model, and calculate the rate constant with units.

title: Crystal Violet Waste Treatment
description: Bleach crystal-violet waste, neutralize it under configured pH rules, and document the disposal decision.

title: Quick Ache Component Property Evidence
description: Experimentally compare pure sucrose, acetaminophen, and aspirin before designing a separation.

title: Quick Ache Separation Design and Approval
description: Design and obtain approval for a safe, evidence-based separation without receiving a hidden recipe.

title: Quick Ache Extraction, Recovery, and Gravimetry
description: Execute an approved separation with safe venting, fraction provenance, filtration, drying, and gravimetry.

title: Quick Ache Composition Analysis
description: Calculate composition and recovery, evaluate consumer hypotheses, and defend the separation with evidence.

title: Gas-Syringe Kinetics with Marble Chips
description: Assemble a safe gas-syringe path, record a controlled carbon-dioxide time series, and calculate an initial rate.

title: Equilibrium Rainbow Inquiry
description: Prepare and stress six reversible systems, record qualitative equilibrium evidence, and design a six-color display.

title: Indicator-free formal pH-volume titration trial
description: Route-only indicator-free formal trial for the three configured acid/base pH-volume contexts; the frozen Cycle 07 carrier remains generator-owned but is not a second indexed technique.
